classification.difficultyReason: For rectangular bases, distinguish two face heights and pair each face base with half the perpendicular base dimension before summing the base and opposite face pairs.

content.prompt:
Calculate the surface area of these pyramids. You will need to find the slant height.
Round your answer to 1 decimal place, where appropriate.

spec.description: Unshaded inverted square pyramid. Four matching base-edge ticks, an 8 m base-edge label, and a dashed 5 m perpendicular height from the marked base centre to the lower apex.
spec.mathematics: Square base side 8 m; perpendicular height 5 m. Model coordinates use a uniform factor of 1/4.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens only; no slant height or surface area supplied.

answer.worked:
Slant height:
$$\begin{aligned}l^2&=5^2+4^2\\l^2&=41\\l&=\sqrt{41}\text{ m}\end{aligned}$$
Area of base:
$$8\times8=64\text{ m}^2$$
Area of front and back triangles:
$$2\times\left(\tfrac12\times8\times\sqrt{41}\right)=8\sqrt{41}\text{ m}^2$$
Area of side triangles:
$$2\times\left(\tfrac12\times8\times\sqrt{41}\right)=8\sqrt{41}\text{ m}^2$$
Total surface area:
$$\begin{aligned}A&=64+8\sqrt{41}+8\sqrt{41}\\A&=64+16\sqrt{41}\\A&\approx166.4\text{ m}^2\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Unshaded upright rectangular pyramid with front base edge 60 mm, right base edge 24 mm and dashed perpendicular height 16 mm ending at a marked base centre. Visibility follows explicit faces and viewing direction.
spec.mathematics: Right rectangular pyramid with base 60 mm by 24 mm and height 16 mm. Model coordinates use a uniform factor of 1/20.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens only; no slant heights or surface area supplied.

answer.worked:
Slant height for the faces with base $60\text{ mm}$:
$$\begin{aligned}x^2&=16^2+12^2\\x^2&=400\\x&=20\text{ mm}\end{aligned}$$
Slant height for the faces with base $24\text{ mm}$:
$$\begin{aligned}y^2&=16^2+30^2\\y^2&=1156\\y&=34\text{ mm}\end{aligned}$$
Area of base:
$$60\times24=1440\text{ mm}^2$$
Area of front and back triangles:
$$2\times\left(\tfrac12\times60\times20\right)=1200\text{ mm}^2$$
Area of side triangles:
$$2\times\left(\tfrac12\times24\times34\right)=816\text{ mm}^2$$
Total surface area:
$$\begin{aligned}A&=1440+1200+816\\A&=3456\text{ mm}^2\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Unshaded upright rectangular pyramid with front base edge 8 cm, left base edge 16 cm and dashed perpendicular height 25 cm ending at a marked base centre. Rear base edges and the hidden apex-to-rear-vertex edge are dashed.
spec.mathematics: Right rectangular pyramid with base 8 cm by 16 cm and height 25 cm. Model coordinates use a uniform factor of 1/10. View exposes the front and left faces.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens only; no slant heights or surface area supplied.

answer.worked:
Slant height for the faces with base $8\text{ cm}$:
$$\begin{aligned}x^2&=25^2+8^2\\x^2&=689\\x&=\sqrt{689}\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$$
Slant height for the faces with base $16\text{ cm}$:
$$\begin{aligned}y^2&=25^2+4^2\\y^2&=641\\y&=\sqrt{641}\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$$
Area of base:
$$8\times16=128\text{ cm}^2$$
Area of front and back triangles:
$$2\times\left(\tfrac12\times8\times\sqrt{689}\right)=8\sqrt{689}\text{ cm}^2$$
Area of side triangles:
$$2\times\left(\tfrac12\times16\times\sqrt{641}\right)=16\sqrt{641}\text{ cm}^2$$
Total surface area:
$$\begin{aligned}A&=128+8\sqrt{689}+16\sqrt{641}\\A&\approx743.1\text{ cm}^2\end{aligned}$$
